End-to-end training for business analysts

BA Lending Academy

Indian lending end to end — LOS, LMS, LWS, collections and the compliance control plane, taught through LoanOS.

Business analysts, implementation consultants and product managers working on LoanOS or a regulated-entity programme.

15 modules78 lessons~22 h totalVerified 17 Jul 2026

Start lesson 1.1 →

A practical learning rhythm

Understand it. Apply it. Check it.

Use the course in sequence for onboarding, or open one lesson when you need a focused refresher.

  1. 01Understand

    Start with the learning outcomes, then connect the process to its regulatory reason.

  2. 02Apply

    Pause at examples and explain what evidence, exception or approval the case needs.

  3. 03Check

    Answer from memory before revealing the explanation; revisit only the section you missed.
